{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
print("Number of invalid revenue entries:", sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Display the first few rows to confirm conversion
sales_df[['revenue', 'converted']].head()"}
